mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT ob.outbound_id, ob.sales_order_item_id FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item ob WHERE ob.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND ob.bundle_component_id IS NOT NULL AND ob.deleted = FALSE GROUP BY ob.outbound_id, ob.sales_order_item_id HAVING COUNT(*) <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_order_bundle_component bc WHERE bc.order_item_id = ob.sales_order_item_id) OR MIN(ob.bundle_sale_quantity) <> MAX(ob.bundle_sale_quantity)) incomplete

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM xsy_delivery_route_order d WHERE d.order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND d.assignment_status = 'ACTIVE' AND d.fulfillment_status IN ('SIGNED', 'EXCEPTION') AND d.deleted = FALSE)

SELECT ro.id AS deliveryRouteOrderId, ro.order_id AS salesOrderId, ro.signed_at AS signedAt, ro.signed_by AS signedBy, o.customer_id AS customerId, o.customer_name_snapshot AS customerNameSnapshot, o.settlement_customer_id AS settlementCustomerId, o.settlement_customer_name_snapshot AS settlementCustomerNameSnapshot FROM xsy_delivery_route_order ro JOIN xsy_sales_order o ON o.id = ro.order_id WHERE ro.id = #{deliveryRouteOrderId} AND ro.deleted = FALSE AND ro.fulfillment_status = 'SIGNED'

SELECT ob.id AS inventoryOutboundItemId, ob.sales_order_item_id AS salesOrderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.product_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, ob.quantity AS quantity, oi.locked_unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.ordered_line_amount AS orderedLineAmount FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item ob JOIN xsy_sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = ob.sales_order_item_id WHERE ob.deleted = FALSE AND ob.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND ob.sales_order_item_id IS NOT NULL AND ob.bundle_component_id IS NULL AND ob.quantity > 0 UNION ALL SELECT MIN(ob.id) AS inventoryOutboundItemId, ob.sales_order_item_id AS salesOrderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.product_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, MAX(ob.bundle_sale_quantity) AS quantity, oi.locked_unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.ordered_line_amount AS orderedLineAmount FROM xsy_inventory_outbound_item ob JOIN xsy_sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = ob.sales_order_item_id WHERE ob.deleted = FALSE AND ob.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND ob.bundle_component_id IS NOT NULL AND ob.quantity > 0 GROUP BY ob.outbound_id, ob.sales_order_item_id, oi.sku_id, oi.product_name_snapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot, oi.locked_unit_price, oi.ordered_line_amount HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM xsy_order_bundle_component bc WHERE bc.order_item_id = ob.sales_order_item_id) AND MIN(ob.bundle_sale_quantity) = MAX(ob.bundle_sale_quantity) ORDER BY inventoryOutboundItemId
SELECT seller_id FROM xsy_sales_order WHERE id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted = FALSE

SELECT rt.id AS orderReturnId, rt.return_no AS returnNo, rt.order_id AS orderId, rt.approved_at AS approvedAt, rt.updated_by AS approvedBy, rt.reason AS reason FROM xsy_order_return rt WHERE rt.id = #{orderReturnId} AND rt.deleted = FALSE AND rt.status = 'APPROVED'

SELECT rt.id AS orderReturnId, rt.return_no AS returnNo, rt.customer_id AS customerId, rt.customer_name_snapshot AS customerNameSnapshot, COALESCE(c.settlement_customer_id, c.id) AS settlementCustomerId, COALESCE(sc.name, c.name) AS settlementCustomerNameSnapshot, rt.approved_at AS approvedAt, rt.updated_by AS approvedBy, rt.reason AS reason FROM xsy_order_return rt JOIN xsy_customer c ON c.id = rt.customer_id AND c.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_customer sc ON sc.id = c.settlement_customer_id AND sc.deleted = FALSE WHERE rt.id = #{orderReturnId} AND rt.deleted = FALSE AND rt.status = 'APPROVED' AND rt.order_id IS NULL

SELECT ri.id AS orderReturnItemId, NULL::bigint AS orderItemId, ri.sku_id AS skuId, ri.sku_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, ri.sale_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, ri.approved_quantity AS approvedQuantity, ri.locked_unit_price AS lockedUnitPrice, ri.approved_amount AS approvedAmount, NULL::numeric AS orderedLineAmount FROM xsy_order_return_item ri WHERE ri.return_id = #{orderReturnId} AND ri.deleted = FALSE AND ri.approved_quantity > 0 AND ri.approved_amount > 0 ORDER BY ri.id
SELECT rt.id FROM xsy_order_return rt WHERE rt.order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND rt.deleted = FALSE AND rt.status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY rt.id

SELECT ri.id AS orderReturnItemId, ri.order_item_id AS orderItemId, oi.sku_id AS skuId, oi.product_name_snapshot AS skuNameSnapshot, oi.sale_unit_snapshot AS unitSnapshot, ri.approved_quantity AS approvedQuantity, ri.locked_unit_price AS lockedUnitPrice, ri.approved_amount AS approvedAmount, oi.ordered_line_amount AS orderedLineAmount FROM xsy_order_return_item ri JOIN xsy_sales_order_item oi ON oi.id = ri.order_item_id WHERE ri.return_id = #{orderReturnId} AND ri.deleted = FALSE AND ri.approved_quantity > 0 AND ri.approved_amount > 0 ORDER BY ri.id

SELECT (allocation ->> 'orderItemId')::bigint AS orderItemId, (allocation ->> 'discountAmount')::numeric AS discountAmount FROM xsy_order_discount od CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(od.allocations) AS allocation WHERE od.sales_order_id = #{salesOrderId}

SELECT id AS orderItemId, actual_quantity AS actualQuantity, ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, locked_unit_price AS lockedUnitPrice, ordered_line_amount AS orderedLineAmount FROM xsy_sales_order_item WHERE order_id = #{salesOrderId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id

SELECT order_id AS salesOrderId, id AS orderItemId, actual_quantity AS actualQuantity, ordered_quantity AS orderedQuantity, locked_unit_price AS lockedUnitPrice, ordered_line_amount AS orderedLineAmount FROM xsy_sales_order_item WHERE deleted = FALSE AND order_id IN #{id} ORDER BY order_id, id

SELECT od.sales_order_id AS salesOrderId, (allocation ->> 'orderItemId')::bigint AS orderItemId, (allocation ->> 'discountAmount')::numeric AS discountAmount FROM xsy_order_discount od CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(od.allocations) AS allocation WHERE od.sales_order_id IN #{id}

SELECT o.id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.seller_id AS sellerId, o.customer_id AS customerId, (o.settlement_method = 'COD') AS codSettlement FROM xsy_sales_order o WHERE o.id = #{salesOrderId} AND o.deleted = FALSE
